source_image.alpha_channel: present but fully opaque in the supplied raster

brand_context.logo_role: primary mascot/application icon with integrated core emblem

visual_summary: A centered black-background neon ghost mascot with a thick magenta-to-cyan glowing outline. The face is a rounded browser-like visor with dark indigo fill and three colored status dots. The chest contains the updated core emblem: a segmented globe/circuit disc crossed by a sharp diagonal lightning bolt, rendered in a matching magenta-purple-blue-cyan gradient.

safe_area.recommended_min_clearspace: 12% of canvas width on all sides for app icons and social avatars
safe_area.minimum_clearspace: 8% of canvas width when space constrained
safe_area.notes: Do not crop the lower wave tips or top arch. The silhouette is taller than it is wide, so square icon placements need vertical breathing room.

observed_palette.name: Neon Magenta
observed_palette.usage: left ghost outline, left emblem segments

observed_palette.name: Electric Cyan
observed_palette.usage: right ghost outline, right emblem segments

observed_palette.name: Deep Indigo Fill
observed_palette.usage: visor fill and subtle interior glow

gradient_recipe.primary_stroke: linear/sweep blend from #F00EF4 at left to #9634F9 through center to #12D5FB at right
gradient_recipe.emblem: magenta and blue segmented globe with a purple lightning bolt; maintain black negative-space cuts between segments
gradient_recipe.glow: soft outer bloom in the local stroke color, strongest around cyan/magenta edges, never overpowering the linework

color_system.contrast_notes: The full-color mark is optimized for black and very dark backgrounds. For light backgrounds, use a dark tile, an outlined container, or a dedicated light-mode variant.

geometry_and_style.line_quality: thick rounded neon vector strokes with soft bloom and crisp inner edges
geometry_and_style.silhouette: friendly ghost body with tall rounded arch, tapering sides, and three rounded wave lobes along the bottom edge
geometry_and_style.visor: rounded rectangular browser/AR visor with concave lower center notch and three small circular controls
geometry_and_style.core_emblem: segmented globe/circuit disc with diagonal lightning bolt overlay; black negative-space gaps define the internal cuts
geometry_and_style.depth_model: mostly flat vector mark with glow and gentle inner shading; avoid realistic 3D materials unless creating a separate 3D variant
edge_rules: Preserve clean black negative-space channels inside the core emblem.
Do not thicken the lightning bolt until it merges with globe segments.
Do not reduce dot contrast; they communicate active agent status.

semantic_prompt_profile.short_prompt: Neon darbot ghost mascot on black, browser visor, three status dots, cyber globe lightning emblem on chest, magenta-purple-cyan gradient, crisp vector glow.
semantic_prompt_profile.full_generation_prompt: Create a clean futuristic logo on a pitch-black square canvas: a friendly ghost-shaped autonomous agent mascot with a thick glowing neon outline. The outline transitions from hot magenta on the left through purple to electric cyan on the right. The face is a dark indigo rounded browser/AR visor with three small status dots in red, cyan, and green. Centered on the chest is the updated core emblem: a segmented globe/circuit disc crossed by a sharp diagonal lightning bolt, using the same magenta-purple-blue-cyan gradient and black negative-space cuts. Style is polished vector, crisp edges, soft neon bloom, high contrast, no text.
semantic_prompt_profile.negative_prompt: No words, no letters, no watermark, no extra mascots, no horror ghost, no skull, no messy gradients, no photographic texture, no flat gray background, no clutter, no low-resolution pixelation, no asymmetric accidental warping, no cropped outline, no overblown glow hiding the emblem.
semantic_prompt_profile.alt_text: Neon Darbot ghost mascot with a browser visor and a glowing globe lightning emblem on its chest.
semantic_prompt_profile.caption: Darbot updated ghost logo with the Cypherdyne-style lightning globe core emblem.

avoid: placing full-color mark directly on white without a dark container
replacing the core emblem with unrelated symbols
using the full mascot below 64 px when the chest emblem must remain legible

minimum_sizes.favicon: use simplified emblem-only or ghost-head variant at 16/32 px

accessibility.primary_alt_text: Neon Darbot ghost with visor and lightning globe emblem
accessibility.decorative_usage: Mark as decorative only when adjacent text already names Darbot.
accessibility.motion_safety: Animated glow should be subtle; avoid rapid flashing or high-frequency pulsing.

variant_notes.small_size_simplified: Reduce internal globe cuts and simplify glow at 16–48 px.
variant_notes.transparent_background: Keep enough dark interior/outline contrast or export with a subtle dark halo; never rely on glow alone over busy imagery.
variant_notes.print_safe_cmyk: Neon RGB colors will compress in print. Use a dedicated proofed CMYK approximation or spot-color treatment.

exports.background: transparent plus optional black rectangle layer

quality_assurance_checklist: Confirm vector source exactly matches the supplied raster silhouette, visor, and core emblem.
Verify black negative-space cuts inside the globe and lightning remain clean at 128 px and 64 px.
Check app icon safe-area crop on iOS, Android, GitHub, Discord, X, LinkedIn, and browser favicon contexts.
Run dark-mode and light-mode background tests.
Export 1x, 2x, and 4x raster sets from vector source instead of scaling small PNGs upward.
Validate SVG gradients and filters in Chromium, Safari, Firefox, and embedded WebView renderers.
Compress PNGs losslessly after export; do not use lossy compression for master or app icons.
Keep a changelog entry for the emblem replacement and version number.
